label: Česká národní banka - kurzy devizového trhu
terms_note: CNB publishes the daily CZK exchange-rate fixing as text files (documentation in Czech on the page above, 'Formát denního kurzu' / 'Kurzy za celý rok'). rok.txt?rok=YYYY is text/plain, '|'-separated, header 'Datum|1 AUD|...|100 JPY|...', dates DD.MM.YYYY and decimal commas. Docs vs live 2026-10-01: an out-of-range year (rok=1900) is not an error - it silently answers the current year, so the server sends only the year of `start`. CNB also offers a JSON API (api.cnb.cz) not used here.

get_series.note: CZK per unit(s) of a currency for every fixing day of ONE calendar year: the year of `start` (default: the current year); `end` is not used. series_id is the column exactly as CNB heads it, amount and code: '1 USD', '1 EUR', '100 JPY', '1000 IDR'.

not_offered.search_symbols: No series list endpoint; the column headers of rok.txt are the series (see get_series).
